module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 100

**Verbatim statement (WOWII #100, status O):**
> If G is a simple connected graph, then α(G) ≤ CEIL[(maximum of λ(v) + 0.5*length(Ḡ))/2]

**Source:** http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/all.html#conj100

The WOWII HTML uses `length(Ḡ)` (the bar denotes graph complement); the
extracted JSON in our private repo previously dropped the overline. The
formal statement below uses the Euclidean norm of the degree sequence of `Gᶜ`.

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

## Definition of graph length

The WOWII definitions popup defines `length(H)` as the square root of the sum
of the squares of the vertex degrees. This is `degreeL2Norm H` in Lean.
Combined with the overline above, the inequality reads:
  `α(G) ≤ ⌈(max_v l(v) + 0.5 · degreeL2Norm(Gᶜ)) / 2⌉`
where `l(v) = indepNeighbors G v`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture100

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 100](http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/all.html#conj100)
(status O):

For a simple connected graph `G`,
`α(G) ≤ ⌈(max_v l(v) + 0.5 · degreeL2Norm(Gᶜ)) / 2⌉`
where `α(G) = G.indepNum` is the independence number,
`max_v l(v)` is the maximum over all vertices of the independence number of
the neighbourhood (in `G`), and `degreeL2Norm(Gᶜ)` is the square root of the
sum of the squares of the degrees in the complement `Gᶜ`.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture100 (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.Connected) :
    let maxL := (Finset.univ.image (indepNeighborsCard G)).max' (by simp)
    (G.indepNum : ℝ) ≤ ⌈((maxL : ℝ) + (1 / 2) * (degreeL2Norm Gᶜ : ℝ)) / 2⌉ := by
  sorry

-- Sanity checks

/-- The independence number is nonneg. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) : 0 ≤ G.indepNum := Nat.zero_le _

/-- The Euclidean norm of the degree sequence is nonnegative. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] : 0 ≤ degreeL2Norm G :=
  Real.sqrt_nonneg _

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture100

findings.description: The section-level `[Nontrivial α]` restricts the theorem to graphs with at least two vertices, whereas the cited statement only says “simple connected graph.” This restriction is not redundant: the singleton graph is connected, its independence number is 1, its maximum local independence number is 0, and its complement has degree L2 norm 0. Thus the displayed inequality becomes the false statement 1 ≤ 0. All quantities, including `max'`, are well-defined on this graph. I verified the singleton's connectivity and the negation of the inequality in Lean. Excluding this degenerate counterexample is defensible, but I could not establish a source convention justifying the exclusion; the formalization silently states the nontrivial-graph version.
findings.source_evidence: WOWII #100 says: “If G is a simple connected graph, then α(G) ≤ CEIL[(maximum of λ(v) + 0.5*length(Ḡ))/2]”, with no explicit lower bound on the order. See http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/all.html#conj100, read through the 2026-07-26 archive. Its linked `wowIIdefs.js`, definitions 4, 5, and 44, defines local independence, independence number, and length in ways that give the singleton values above.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm whether #100 is intended only for graphs with at least two vertices. If so, retain `[Nontrivial α]` but explicitly document this nondegenerate reading. If the literal domain of all simple connected graphs is intended, replace the restriction by nonemptiness (or obtain nonemptiness from `h`) and record the singleton counterexample, keeping the present statement as a nontrivial-graph variant.

sources_consulted: E. DeLaVina, Graffiti.pc: A Variant of Graffiti, introductory and model-domain discussion: http://web.archive.org/web/20250508011810id_/http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/gpc/Graffitipc.pdf

Local definitions: FormalConjecturesForMathlib/Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/Independence.lean and Degrees.lean; Mathlib's SimpleGraph Basic, Maps, Finite, Clique, and Connectivity definitions, Finset maxima, and integer ceiling definitions.
could_not_verify: WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture100.conjecture100: whether WOWII #100 implicitly excludes the singleton graph. This is the modelling ambiguity reported above, not an established error in the inequality.
review.notes: Apart from the singleton-domain question, the statement matches the source: the complement is correct, both divisions are real arithmetic, and the maximum and ceiling have the intended meanings. Both sanity-check examples are faithful. The archived source records #100 as O (open), matching the category; live source endpoints timed out. Successful scratch checks are in /workspace/review/boundaries.lean, enumerate.lean, and numeric_equivalence.lean. Exact enumeration found no violation among the 771 connected labeled graphs on 2–5 vertices; the arithmetic conversion used for these tests was proved in Lean.
